issues.title: Incorrect revenue calculation
issues.problem: Revenue should only include transactions with status 'COMPLETED', but the query sums all amounts.
issues.fix: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_REVENUE

issues.title: Implicit join syntax
issues.problem: Using implicit join syntax can be less readable and more prone to errors.
issues.fix: FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_customer dc ON ft.CUSTOMER_ID = dc.CUSTOMER_ID

issues.title: Missing table aliases
issues.problem: Table aliases should be used for better readability and to avoid confusion.
issues.fix: FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_customer dc ON ft.CUSTOMER_ID = dc.CUSTOMER_ID

review.corrected_sql: SELECT dc.CUSTOMER_ID, dc.EMAIL, SUM(CASE WHEN ft.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN ft.amount ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_REVENUE FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_customer dc ON ft.CUSTOMER_ID = dc.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY dc.CUSTOMER_ID, dc.EMAIL;
review.summary: The query has a critical correctness issue with revenue calculation and minor readability issues with implicit join syntax and missing table aliases.

issues.title: Potentially Missing Index

CREATE INDEX idx_dim_merchant_merchant_id ON sigma_analytics.dim_merchant(merchant_id);

issues.title: Incorrect Failure Rate Calculation
issues.problem: The query does not correctly calculate the failure rate as it does not filter for 'FAILED' status.
issues.fix: COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100

review.corrected_sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS revenue, (COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) * 100) AS failure_rate
FROM sigma_analytics.fact_transactions ft
JOIN sigma_analytics.dim_merchant dm ON ft.merchant_id = dm.merchant_id
WHERE status = 'COMPLETED';
review.summary: The query has critical correctness issues with revenue calculation and failure rate. It also has performance and readability issues that need addressing.

issues.title: Missing filter for failure rate calculation
issues.problem: The query does not filter transactions by status to calculate failure rate correctly.
issues.fix: SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED') * 100.0) / COUNT(*) AS failure_rate FROM fact_transactions;
